home.title: Etabat
home.description: Disputes you are involved in — filing, response, mediation, and arbitration
home.privacyNote: An Etab is not public. Only the dispute parties and the mediators or arbitrators selected by the system can see it. Cases where you are selected as a mediator or arbitrator appear in Fahs Mahs, not here.
home.empty: There are no Etabat in this filter.
home.emptyDescription: Try another filter to see the rest of your Etabat.

case.todoTitle: What you need to do now: respond
case.todoText: You have two days to respond and upload evidence. If the deadline passes without a response, the case proceeds to mediation with this account only.
case.responseIntro: Write your account of what happened. Mediators read the complaint and response together before the first session.
case.whatHappenedHint: In chronological order — mention any circumstance that changed the schedule
case.solution: Do you have a proposed solution?
case.solutionHint: A written proposal can save a full mediation session
case.optionalHint: Optional — a reasonable proposal resolves many cases during mediation without arbitration.
case.uploadHint: PDF · PNG · JPG — up to 5 files
case.responseLock: After you send the response, you cannot edit it. You can add new evidence during mediation.

validation.responseRequired: Write your account before sending the response.
validation.responseMin: Your response must be at least 10 characters.

case.exchangeIntro: It was locked automatically when the complaint was filed. Both parties can see it, but nobody can edit it.
case.currencyHeld: The currency is held from the time the complaint was filed. It is not transferred until the case closes.
timeline: The claimant filed the complaint. The exchange file was locked and the currency was held.
Your turn. If the deadline passes, mediation continues without your response.
The system selects three mediators. It fails automatically if no settlement is reached in time.
Five arbitrators and a deposit per arbitrator apply to this balance-linked case.
A larger panel reviews the appeal with a doubled deposit.

exchangeComplaint.title: File a complaint
exchangeComplaint.subtitle: Linked to an exchange · Mishkat for Culture
exchangeComplaint.chooseTitle: Which exchange is this complaint about?
exchangeComplaint.chooseIntro: Choose the exchange and the system will attach its complete file automatically.
exchangeComplaint.generalNote: A complaint not linked to an exchange — harassment, fraud, rule misuse, or a membership-suspension proposal — is filed as a general complaint.
exchangeComplaint.attachmentsIntro: These are the exchange records as stored in the system. They are locked when the complaint is filed, which makes them evidence.
exchangeComplaint.detailsHint: In chronological order — what was agreed, what actually happened, and when
exchangeComplaint.detailsHelp: Mediators and arbitrators read this before anything else.
exchangeComplaint.requestHint: For example: deliver the remaining sessions within two weeks
exchangeComplaint.uploadHint: PDF · PNG · JPG — up to 5 files
exchangeComplaint.deadline: Maximum duration for a service-linked complaint: 15 business days. A complaint not linked to a service has a one-month duration.
nextSteps: The other party sees the complaint and attached file, then responds with their evidence.
The system selects three mediators to work with both parties on a settlement.
If mediation fails, either party can continue with a deposit and an anonymous arbitration panel.
Either party can appeal to a larger panel with a doubled deposit.

validation.detailsMin: Details must be at least 10 characters.

generalComplaint.title: General complaint
generalComplaint.subtitle: Not linked to an exchange · Mishkat for Culture
generalComplaint.intro: A general complaint concerns conduct, not an exchange. If the dispute concerns an agreed service or resource, file an exchange complaint so its records are attached automatically.
generalComplaint.kindIntro: The type determines the Code of Conduct penalty category if the complaint reaches arbitration.

harassment.title: Harassment or abuse
harassment.description: Abusive conduct, threats, or discrimination toward a member or organization team.

fraud.title: Fraud
fraud.description: A false claim or a currency transfer for something that was never delivered.

rules.title: Rule misuse
rules.description: Exploiting a system loophole — fake accounts, reciprocal ratings, or cycling balances.

exclusion.title: Suspension or exclusion proposal
exclusion.description: A request to suspend an organization membership or exclude it from the network.

generalComplaint.membershipNote: Exclusion cases are resolved here, not under organization membership — that area is for joining only.
generalComplaint.targetPlaceholder: Search by organization or member name
generalComplaint.targetHint: Start typing and the system completes from network members.
generalComplaint.detailsPlaceholder: Write chronologically — dates, place, and who was present
generalComplaint.requestPlaceholder: For example: a written apology or a three-month suspension
generalComplaint.uploadHint: PDF · PNG · JPG — up to 5 files
generalComplaint.differenceTitle: How this differs from an exchange complaint
generalComplaint.warning: This complaint is not linked to a balance, so the deposit is the minimum — 40 units, doubled with each appeal — and arbitration starts with seven arbitrators instead of five. The maximum processing duration is one month from filing.

validation.detailsMin: Details must be at least 10 characters.

start.title: Start arbitration
start.intro: Mediation failed on 4 October. Whoever wishes to continue pays a deposit and an anonymous arbitration panel decides. Its decision binds both parties. The deposit makes arbitration the last resort.
start.depositFine: 2% × {dispute} = {perArbitrator} {currency} per arbitrator, × {panel} arbitrators = {deposit} {currency}. This exceeds the minimum. For a case not linked to a balance, the deposit is the minimum {minimum} {currency} and the panel begins with 7 arbitrators instead of 5.
start.ladderTitle: The deposit doubles on every appeal
start.ladderIntro: Each appeal has twice as many arbitrators as the previous panel plus one, and twice the deposit. Repeated arbitration has a deliberate cost.
start.ladderNote: For a case not linked to a balance, the ladder starts at 7 arbitrators and 40 {currency}: 7 → 15 → 31 → 63 arbitrators, and 40 → 80 → 160 → 320 {currency}.
start.loanNote: Your balance does not cover the deposit. The system lends you {loan} {currency} and adds it to your debt, repaid from the next {currency} you earn. Arbitration is not stopped by a low balance, but the debt remains recorded.
start.loanConsent: I agree to borrow {loan} {currency} from the system and add it to my debt.
start.fateWin: Your deposit is returned in full, and the other party's deposit is distributed.
start.fateLoseTitle: If the decision goes against you
start.fateLose: Your deposit is not returned. It is distributed to arbitrators whose ruling matches the Schelling point, meaning the panel majority. A dissenting arbitrator receives none of it.
start.fateReward: Each matching arbitrator receives a 10 {currency} reward in addition to their share of the deposit and their security back.
start.scheduleNote: An arbitrator who misses the deadline loses their 10 {currency} security and another 10 from their balance, then loses their seat. The system appoints a replacement with the same deadline.
start.bindingConsent: I understand that the panel's decision is binding and {currency} is not transferred until the appeal window closes.
start.submitted: The arbitration request has been submitted. Follow the case in Etabat.

result.title: Arbitration result
result.appealNote: 3 business days remain. The held {currency} ({amount}) is not transferred until the window closes, even if nobody intends to appeal.
result.reasonsIntro: This combines the reasons of arbitrators whose ruling matched the Schelling point. Their names remain private; individual reasons stay in the case file.
result.reasons: The delay is established and acknowledged, but the agreement set no penalty for delay. A written notice about the instructor's health was sent on 8 September. The panel found a scheduling breach, not a breach of the whole agreement, so the lightest penalty applies. The other party must deliver the two remaining sessions within 10 business days of the appeal window closing; the exchange then closes at its full value.
result.dissentNote: One arbitrator dissented and ruled for {party}. Their view remains in the file, but it does not change the decision and they receive no share of the deposit.
result.depositFateIntro: The losing party forfeits their deposit. It goes to arbitrators matching the Schelling point. The dissenting arbitrator only recovers their security.
result.matchedLine: {share} from the deposit + {reward} reward + {security} security returned
result.dissentLine: Only the 10 {currency} security is returned — no reward or deposit share
result.nextTitle: What happens if the window closes without an appeal
nextSteps: A written warning stays on {party}'s record for one year. It does not affect the balance or Hakima voting.
The transfers shown above happen automatically.
The remaining two sessions take place within 10 business days; then {amount} {currency} is transferred and the exchange closes.
It moves to Closed in Etabat, while both parties retain access to the file.

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.subtitle: E-{id} · 3 business days until the window closes
appeal.intro: The appeal reconsiders the case from the beginning before a new, larger panel, following the same two stages. The new panel cannot see the earlier ruling before it decides.
appeal.doubling: Doubling — each appeal costs twice the previous one
appeal.depositFine: The increase is deliberate. Each appeal costs the network more arbitrators and time, so the requesting party bears the cost.
appeal.ladderTitle: Where we are on the ladder
appeal.existingDebt: Existing debt from the first-round deposit
appeal.loanNote: The system lends you the full {deposit} and adds it to your debt. If the appeal fails, the deposit is not returned and the {debt} {currency} debt is repaid from future earnings.
appeal.loanConsent: I agree to borrow {deposit} {currency} and add it to my debt.
appeal.reasonIntro: Do not rewrite the complaint. Explain what the first panel missed or read incorrectly.
appeal.reasonPlaceholder: Point to a specific agreement clause or evidence in the file that the ruling missed
appeal.upload: Upload files not present in the first round
appeal.uploadHint: PDF · PNG · JPG — up to 5 files
appeal.outcomesIntro: There are two outcomes, each affecting both parties and the first panel.
appeal.keepTitle: The new panel upholds the decision
keepLines: Distributed to appeal arbitrators matching the Schelling point
appeal.flipTitle: The new panel reverses the decision
flipLines: Each arbitrator on the reversed first panel
First-panel arbitrators matching the appeal outcome
appeal.outcomesNote: The one first-round dissenter who ruled for {party} benefits if the appeal succeeds. This gives arbitrators a reason to decide independently.
appeal.scheduleNote: The same deadline applies to appeal arbitrators. Anyone who misses it loses their 10 {currency} security, another 10 from their balance, and their seat; the system appoints a replacement.
appeal.bindingConsent: I understand the appeal panel's decision is binding and {currency} stays held until the new appeal window closes.
appeal.submitted: The appeal has been submitted. Follow the case in Etabat.

validation.reasonMin: The reason must be at least 10 characters.
